name: Bluegrass roots of the cypherpunk scene deep-dives

mentions.name: Bluegrass roots of the cypherpunk scene deep-dives
mentions.description: A series of personal research deep-dives exploring the bluegrass roots of the early Bay Area cypherpunk scene and the author's thesis that traditional music and a free internet are connected, arguing that traditional music lives outside the copyright and intellectual property complex and naturally fuels innovation of free ideas.
mentions.source_excerpt: As some of you have followed, I have done a few deep-dives into the bluegrass roots of the early Bay Area cypherpunk scene.  Because traditional music necessarily lives outside the complex of copyright and intellectual property, I believe it is a natural and necessary fuel of innovation of free ideas.
